name: Handloom Dhakai Jamdani Saree
description: Authentic hand-woven Dhakai Jamdani saree crafted on traditional pit looms in Rupganj, Narayanganj. Features geometric floral 'panna hajar' motifs in fine 84-count Egyptian cotton with subtle gold zari threadwork.

name: Tangail Handloom Cotton Taant Saree
description: Classic lightweight breathable Tangail handloom cotton saree woven with fine combed yarn. Features an intricate 'meenakari' jacquard border with fresh mint and mustard temple motifs, ideal for summer and daily festive elegance.

specs.Care: Gentle Hand Wash with Mild Detergent

name: Mirpur Bridal Katan Silk Saree
description: Exquisite heavy Katan silk saree woven by master weavers in the Benarasi Palli of Mirpur, Dhaka. Embellished with royal crimson warp and dual-tone gold brocade borders for weddings and grand festive celebrations.

name: Premium Semi-Silk Embroidered Panjabi
description: Sophisticated semi-silk tailored Panjabi featuring delicate hand-embroidery along the band collar and placket. Midnight navy with subtle sheen, tailored cuffs, and engraved metallic buttons, tailored for Eid prayers and family gatherings.

name: Comilla Khadi Cotton Summer Panjabi
description: Authentic hand-spun and hand-woven Khadi Panjabi from Chandina, Comilla. Natural unbleached ivory texture with minimalist wooden buttons, exceptionally cool and breathable in tropical warmth.

name: Rajshahi Pure Mulberry Silk Shawl
description: Featherlight pure mulberry silk shawl handcrafted by sericulture artisans in Rajshahi. Features a rich gradient dyed finish with hand-twisted tassels and subtle metallic border accents.

specs.Care: Gentle Silk Wash or Dry Clean

name: Traditional Nakshi Kantha Heritage Quilt
description: Museum-grade hand-embroidered Nakshi Kantha quilt sewn over four months by rural women artisans in Jessore. Features traditional folk motifs including tree of life, rural village life, and floral mandalas on layered soft cotton.

specs.Care: Gentle Machine Wash on Delicate Cycle

name: Dhamrai Hand-Cast Brass Tea Pot & Cups Set
description: Solid brass artisanal tea service set crafted using traditional lost-wax casting in Dhamrai, keeping a 200-year-old Dhaka metallurgy craft alive. Includes 1 handcrafted teapot, 4 etched brass cups, and a heavy brass serving platter.

specs.Care: Clean with Lemon and Salt or Brass Polish

name: Old Dhaka Rickshaw Art Painted Tray
banglaName: পুরান ঢাকার রিকশা পেইন্টিং কাঠের ট্রে
description: Vibrant wooden tea serving tray hand-painted with genuine Old Dhaka rickshaw enamel art. Features the iconic peacock and cinematic floral motifs painted by master rickshaw ustaads in Bangshal, Dhaka.

specs.Material: Solid Sheesham Wood with Lacquer Finish
specs.Care: Wipe Clean with Damp Microfiber Cloth

name: Clay Terracotta Matir Cha Cups (Pack of 6)
description: Kiln-fired earthenware Matir Cha cups sculpted from mineral-rich Padma river silt in Rayerbazar. Imparts the authentic earthy petrichor aroma to spiced milk tea (Doodh Cha) or Malai Cha.

specs.Care: Rinse with Warm Water Before First Use

name: Sundarbans Raw Wildflower Organic Honey
description: Wild multifloral mangrove honey collected deep within the Sundarbans forest by traditional Mawali beekeepers. Unpasteurized and unfiltered, retaining natural pollen, royal jelly, and rich antioxidants.

specs.Purity Guarantee: Zero Added Corn Syrup or Sugar

name: Kalojira Fragrant Polao & Biryani Rice
description: Premium aged Kalojira (Chinigura) micro-grain aromatic rice cultivated in Dinajpur. Known for its mesmerizing aroma and non-sticky fluffy texture, essential for Eid Morog Polao, Kacchi Biryani, and Payesh.

name: Pure Cold-Pressed Ghani Mustard Oil (1L)
description: Traditional wooden ghani-pressed pungent mustard oil made from indigenous black and yellow mustard seeds. Delivers the authentic spicy kick (jhaal) essential for Ilish Macher Jhol, shutki bhorta, and winter pickles.

name: Cox's Bazar Sun-Dried Loitta Fish (Shutki)
description: Carefully selected Loitta fish naturally sun-dried on clean coastal wooden platforms in Nazirartek, Cox's Bazar. Free from chemical preservatives, DDT, or artificial dyes.

specs.Preparation: Soak in Warm Water 15 Mins Before Cooking

name: Handmade Narkel Naru & Date Gur Sandesh Box
banglaName: ঐতিহ্যবাহী নারিকেল নাড়ু ও খেজুর গুড়ের মিষ্টি বক্স
description: Handcrafted assortment of 12 artisan treats: 6 cardamom-infused coconut naru balls and 6 soft-caramelized Sandesh crafted with pure Jessore/Faridpur Date Palm Molasses (Khejur Gur).

specs.Key Ingredients: Fresh Coconut, Khejur Nolen Gur, Chhana

name: Hazaribagh Full-Grain Cowhide Leather Wallet
description: Minimalist bifold wallet crafted from vegetable-tanned Bangladeshi full-grain cowhide leather. Hand-stitched with waxed thread, featuring 6 card slots, a currency compartment sized for BDT notes, and integrated RFID protection.

specs.Slots: 6 Card Slots, 2 Slip Pockets, 1 Cash Divider

name: Golden Fibre Jute & Leather Laptop Bag
banglaName: সোনালী আঁশ পাট ও লেদার ল্যাপটপ ব্যাগ
description: Contemporary structured messenger bag crafted from high-density Bangladeshi jute fabric with cognac bridle leather handles and trims. Padded internal compartment holds up to 15.6-inch laptops with dedicated stationery organizers.

specs.Closure: Heavy Duty YKK Antique Brass Zippers

name: Rangpur Heritage Shotoronji Floor Runner
description: Authentic Rangpur Shotoronji flat-weave carpet handwoven on wooden frame looms in Nisbetganj. Reversible geometric diamond pattern in natural terracotta and indigo dyed cotton cords.

specs.Dimensions: 180 cm x 90 cm (6 ft x 3 ft)
specs.Care: Spot Clean or Hand Wash Cold

name: Dhaka Muslin Touch Embroidered Kurti
description: Breezy A-line kurti made with ultra-fine cotton evoking the legendary softness of Dhaka Muslin. Adorned with delicate threadwork on the neckline and bell sleeves in powder ivory and pastel blush.

specs.Style: Contemporary Straight Cut with Side Slits

name: Kumarkhali Handloom Cotton Lungi (Pack of 2)
description: Authentic handloom lungi pair woven in Kumarkhali, Kushtia. Made from pre-washed 60s combed cotton for instant supreme softness, finished with secure double-stitched hems in classic navy and charcoal checkered patterns.
